privacy.metaDescription: How we collect and use your data when you contact the ELSAAD Motorcycle website.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: At ELSAAD Motorcycle we respect your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect when you use our website, how we use it, and how we protect it.

dataCollected.title: Data we collect
dataCollected.body: We only collect the data you submit yourself through the contact form: your name, phone number, and message text (optional). We do not collect any other data through this website.

howUsed.title: How we use data
howUsed.body: We use your data solely to contact you and respond to your inquiry. We do not use it for any marketing purpose without your consent.

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.body: We do not share your data with any third party, sell it, or use it outside the scope of responding to your message.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We may use Google Analytics to understand website visits in aggregate (aggregated figures only, without identifying you personally). You can disable cookies from your browser settings at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request deletion of the data you have sent us at any time. Simply email us at the address below and we will carry out the request without complications.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any question about this policy or your data, contact us at:

terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions for using the ELSAAD Motorcycle website and our protection of intellectual property rights.
terms.heading: Terms and Conditions

acceptance.title: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By using this website you agree to these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any of them, please refrain from using the website.

usage.title: Use of the website
usage.body: The website is provided to present our products and services and to introduce our branches. Use of the website for any unlawful purpose or in violation of these terms is not permitted.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: All content on this website, including texts, images, logos, and trademarks, is owned by or licensed to ELSAAD Motorcycle. Reproducing or republishing any content without prior written permission is prohibited.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: We strive to keep information accurate, but the website is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not responsible for any data errors, service interruptions, or indirect damages arising from use of the website.

external.title: External links
external.body: The website may contain links to other sites (such as WhatsApp and social media). We do not control these sites and are not responsible for their content.

changes.title: Amendments
changes.body: We reserve the right to amend these terms at any time without prior notice; the amendment takes effect immediately upon publication on this page.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt, and any dispute shall be referred to the competent authorities in Egypt.
